L3169.83bol. Alerander of Lomsille formerly May, Alesance who kept ihe dolchers Home en Wastunti pack anny otheservants- one Leusa Rudd. who had been the propert, of his wife Salli Rudd - and one Wastey Villiams who bevame the husband of omie Lounn while in Lesielle. and they hact four chelden. To of which Many &hobet then lich melt them to tholay t ane to dhas Rachael. and Jeresa une left eri Louille with copt. Rudol, on As alexande-and
Nou ath Me. Alescondu, When May Pelesandu vent to Forcille in it Gr n 3, Lonesa A Hesla, Mllåms, declenese gua wath him, and remained mi Was kut - On the Boar St Nicholas plyu helicen Wexanda the Mother of Trees Weston) illions Jitashunster, ho deries to hear frem her ano ushes to tele her and her husband to send E
# a. andrews. 62 I maso. Celli y cid to c. B
